verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents its own webhooks that notify your application of account activity and asynchronous transaction status updates, plus a specific sell_transaction_requote_required off-ramp event. Together these give server-side state tracking without polling. However, nothing in the pack shows signature verification, and the requested event types (payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed) are not enumerated. missing for 10: evidence that webhooks are signed/verifiable, a documented event catalog covering payment confirmation, payout settlement and swap/conversion execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
